component.name: HttpTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "run" end sub
sub run() m.top.done = false m.top.error = "" m.top.status = -1 m.top.response = ""
xfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") xfer.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") xfer.EnablePeerVerification(true) xfer.SetUrl(m.top.url)
if UCase(m.top.method) = "POST" xfer.AddHeader("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8") port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") xfer.SetPort(port) if not xfer.AsyncPostFromString(m.top.body) m.top.error = "Falha ao iniciar a requisição." m.top.done = true return end if msg = Wait(20000, port) if Type(msg) = "roUrlEvent" m.top.status = msg.GetResponseCode() if msg.GetResponseCode() >= 0 m.top.response = msg.GetString() else m.top.error = msg.GetFailureReason() end if else m.top.error = "Tempo esgotado." xfer.AsyncCancel() end if else m.top.response = xfer.GetToString() if Len(m.top.response) = 0 m.top.error = "Resposta vazia." else m.top.status = 200 end if end if
m.top.done = true end sub
